title: AI Controls Matrix v1.1
summary: A vendor-agnostic control framework for cloud-based AI systems, built on the CSA Cloud Controls Matrix: 247 control objectives across 18 security domains, released 22 June 2026, with mappings to ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 27001 and BSI AIC4. Sixi Assure cites domains and control ids as a crosswalk; a finding always comes from a rule and a clause, never from the matrix alone.
note: Verified 2026-09-16 against the CSA artifact page fetched from cloudsecurityalliance.org. The page states 247 control objectives across 18 security domains and the mappings; it does not enumerate the domains. Licence: CSA material is not openly licensed and CSA sells commercial licences for its matrices, so Sixi Assure stores the control or domain identifier and its own paraphrase only — AICM control text is never reproduced. Confirm the terms with CSA before any wider use.

title: Model Development Security

title: Consensus Assessment Initiative Questionnaire for AI
summary: The questionnaire that accompanies the AICM and underpins a STAR Level 1 self-assessment. The questions of the form "is X architecturally present?" are the ones a drawing can evidence; process, contract and personnel questions are not. A STAR level is an audit outcome and is never a Sixi Assure output.
